terms.comment: misereor takes the genitive: miserēre meī, have mercy on me; miserēre nōbīs in the Glōria. The response of the litanies in both churches.

Greek Κύριε, ἐλέησον, in Latin letters: so it is sung in the Roman Mass, and so, in Greek or Slavonic, in the litanies of the Byzantine services. Greek in Latin letters is left without macrons, as the Missal prints it.

phrases.english: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us
Jesus, master, have mercy on us (the ten lepers).

phrases.latin: Quī tollis peccāta mundī, miserēre nōbīs.
phrases.english: You who take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us.
